method: Exact full gained swept-ID counts. At most512 deterministic screen samples per camera, raycast actual indexed Float32 world-position triangles using exact recorded perspective camera. Swept vertex projection is identity vec3(position). Filter nearest CPU ray hits using node-centred bilinear mask and supplied GPU dither +/-1/255 uncertainty; classify sampled front/profile rows, lift/weights and depth relative to retained GPU-displaced original water. This is bounded attribution, not exact GPU triangle-ID instrumentation.
